name: Dynamic Equi-Depth Histogram Binning via NTILE in Pure SQL
description: Creating balanced feature histograms for ML requires equal-depth binning (each bucket contains an equal number of records) rather than equal-width binning.
prompt:
Creating balanced feature histograms for ML requires equal-depth binning (each bucket contains an equal number of records) rather than equal-width binning.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: spend_quartile, customer_count, min_spend_in_bin, max_spend_in_bin, avg_spend_in_bin.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Partition customers into 4 equal-depth spending quartiles (bins)
            WITH binned AS (
                SELECT 
                    customer_id,
                    annual_spend,
                    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY annual_spend ASC) AS spend_quartile
                FROM customer_spend
            )
            SELECT 
                spend_quartile,
                COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
                MIN(annual_spend) AS min_spend_in_bin,
                MAX(annual_spend) AS max_spend_in_bin,
                ROUND(AVG(annual_spend), 2) AS avg_spend_in_bin
            FROM binned
            GROUP BY spend_quartile
            ORDER BY spend_quartile;
why_it_fails: Equal-width bins leave high-value tail bins completely empty on skewed power-law distributions.
